sql: SELECT TOP 10 MIN(bl.BrandName) AS brand, b.BrandCode AS code FROM dbo.ZnodeBrandDetails b INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeBrandDetailLocale bl ON bl.BrandId = b.BrandId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalBrand pb ON pb.BrandId = b.BrandId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortal p ON p.PortalId = pb.PortalId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimProduct pp ON pp.Brand = b.BrandCode WHERE p.StoreCode = @store AND b.BrandCode = @brand AND b.IsActive = @brandActive AND pp.IsActive = @productActive AND (@preferred IS NULL OR bl.BrandName = @preferred) GROUP BY b.BrandId, b.BrandCode HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pp.PimProductId) >= @minProducts ORDER BY b.BrandCode
